zh-CN.title: 广场评论体验优化
items: 评论表情面板新增探索页，并支持点击外部快速收起
官方与运营不再受广场发言和评论次数限制，匿名发言收到评论时也会及时提醒

en.title: Improved Square comments
items: The comment emoji picker now includes Explore and closes when you tap outside it
Official and operator accounts no longer have Square posting limits, and comments on anonymous posts now trigger notifications
